items.difficulty_reason: 22 行、Noetherian 逼近模板（相对完美版）：①引用 compare-base-change 引理（本线 L22116 的同名桩 08IB）把命题压缩成「证 Rf_*E perfect」；②仿射化 R = colim R_i，下降 X_i（finite presentation）、proper + flat（Limits 两引理）、E_i（R_i-perfect，descend-relatively-perfect 引理）；③对 R_i 应用 perfect-direct-image 引理（本线 L22120），再用已证的 base change 传回 R。承重的逼近链条全在 span 内；7 处引用（3 同章、4 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-derived-pushforward-rel-perfect (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 9187-9193

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the citation of the base change part, the Noetherian approximation reduction, the descent of the proper flat finitely presented scheme and of the S-perfect object over a filtered colimit of Noetherian rings, and the application of the Noetherian perfect direct image lemma to the descended datum (source lines 9195-9216)
